title: Suspicious process indicator
recommendation: Terminate the process only after collecting forensic evidence.

title: Suspicious scheduled task
recommendation: Disable task and inspect referenced executable/script.

title: Windows licensing service stopped
recommendation: Confirm this is expected; unexpected stoppage may indicate tampering.

title: Defender settings changed
evidence:
Microsoft Defender Antivirus Configuration has changed. If this is an unexpected event you should review the settings as this may be the result of malware.
 	Old value: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\UX Configuration\ToastOrSsoTrigger = 0x0
 	New value: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\UX Configuration\ToastOrSsoTrigger = 0x1
recommendation: Validate if policy change was authorized.
